starterCode:
# 被动语态探索台
tense = 1   # 1一般现在 2一般过去 3一般将来 4现在完成 5现在进行 6过去完成

hide()
be = "am / is / are"
name = "一般现在时"
ex = "English is loved by everyone."
if tense == 2:
    be = "was / were"
    name = "一般过去时"
    ex = "The bridge was built in 1990."
if tense == 3:
    be = "will be"
    name = "一般将来时"
    ex = "A new school will be built here."
if tense == 4:
    be = "has / have been"
    name = "现在完成时"
    ex = "The work has been finished."
if tense == 5:
    be = "is / are being"
    name = "现在进行时"
    ex = "The road is being repaired now."
if tense == 6:
    be = "had been"
    name = "过去完成时"
    ex = "The letter had been sent before he came."
fill_rect(0, 120, 360, 30, "#1d4ed8")
write(name + " 被动式", 0, 120, "#fff", 13)
fill_rect(0, 74, 360, 40, "#f1f5f9")
write("be（随时态变）+ done（永不变）", 0, 74, "#dc2626", 12)
fill_rect(-110, 26, 120, 34, "#16a34a")
write(be, -110, 26, "#fff", 12)
fill_rect(20, 26, 120, 34, "#7c3aed")
write("done", 20, 26, "#fff", 12)
fill_rect(0, -30, 360, 44, "#fef3c7")
write("例：" + ex, 0, -30, "#b45309", 11)
write("口诀：被动语态 be 加过表，时态变化全在 be", -40, -85, "#0f172a", 11)
write("不知道/不必说动作执行者时，by 短语可省", -40, -110, "#0369a1", 10)
title: 被动语态：be + done 变形记
textbook: 人教版英语（高中必修二）

points: 被动语态的构成 be + 过去分词

story: Everyone loves English. → English is loved by everyone. 焦点一换，句子就"变身"：动作的承受者站上主语位，动词套上 be + done 的外壳。高考写作里用好被动，句子立刻高级。
goals: 掌握 be + done 的构成逻辑
会写八种常用时态的被动形式

sections.title: 为什么用被动
sections.body:
【当动作的承受者比执行者更重要、或执行者未知时用被动】
The window was broken.（谁打的不重要/不知道）
科技文、新闻报道高频使用被动——客观、正式。

sections.title: 被动三步法
sections.body:
【①宾语提前作主语 ②动词变 be + done ③原主语变 by 短语（可省）】
Everyone loves English. → English is loved (by everyone).
注意 be 的新主语单复数保持一致：They built two schools → Two schools were built.

sections.title: 易错点
sections.body:
【不及物动词没有被动：happen, take place, belong to, come true】
The accident was happened（×）→ The accident happened（√）
短语动词的介词不能丢：The children are taken care of.

examples.q: 把 People speak English all over the world. 改成被动。
steps: 宾语 English 提前作主语
动词变 are spoken（复数主语）
答案：English is spoken by people all over the world
主语 The factory 单数 → has been opened
examples.tip: since 是完成时的信号词

mistakes: be 的单复数不随新主语变化
